source.citation: Thirteenth Census of the United States, 1910: Population. Illinois, Cook County, City of Chicago, Ward 1. NARA microfilm publication other work, roll 241 ("Cook (EDs 114-134, 140-167, 1544, 1601, 1632) County"), digitised from the film and republished by the Internet Archive as item 13thcensus1910po241unit, 1,472 leaves.
what_it_does_not_supply: anything on 1 July 1904; a child seen in 1910 is placed in the 1904 house only by inference from age and the family's listing
children already grown and gone by 1910
households not on Prairie Avenue (the Lowdens, gone by 1910)
what_it_supplies: the children at home in April 1910, by name, with age and relationship to the head
the mothers' counts of children born and living
relationships the Blue Book never prints (a son, a daughter, a sister, a niece)
